title: Diversified cassane family diterpenoids from the leaves of Caesalpinia minax exerting anti-neuroinflammatory activity through suppressing MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways in BV-2 microglia.
authors: Lu, Wang; Chen, Jin-Ting; Shi, Ye-Fan; Chen, Meng-Song; Wang, Pan-Pan; Zhang, Xiu-Juan; Xiao, Chao-Jiang; Li, Ding; Cao, Chen-Yu; Li, Chun-Huan; Gao, Jin-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物二萜类化合物的抗神经炎症活性及NF-kappaB/MAPK通路抑制机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Caesalpinia minax Hance, whose seeds are known as "Ku-shi-lian" in China, have been used in Chinese folk medicine for treatment of rheumatism, dysentery, and skin itching. However, the anti-neuroinflammatory constituents of its leaves and their mechanism are rarely reported. AIM OF THE STUDY: To search for new anti-neuro-inflammatory compounds from the leaves of C. minax and elucidate their mechanism on anti-neuroinflammatory effect. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The main metabolites of the ethyl acetate fraction from C. minax were analyzed and purified via HPLC and various column chromatography techniques. Their structures were elucidated on the basis of 1D and 2D NMR, HR-ESI-MS, and single crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. Anti-neuroinflammatory activity was evaluated in BV-2 microglia cells induced by LPS. The expression levels of molecules in NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways were analyzed through western blotting. Meanwhile, the time- and dose-dependent expression of associated proteins such as iNOS and COX-2 were detected by western blotting. Furthermore, Compounds 1 and 3 were performed on the NF-kappaB p65 active site using molecular docking simulation to elucidate the molecular level inhibition mechanism. RESULTS: 20 cassane diterpenoids, including two novel ones (caeminaxins A and B) were isolated from the leaves of C. minax Hance. Caeminaxins A and B possessed a rare unsaturated carbonyl moiety in their structures. Most of the metabolites exhibited potent inhibition effects with IC(50) values ranging from 10.86 +/- 0.82 to 32.55 +/- 0.47 muM. Among them, caeminaxin A inhibited seriously the expression of iNOS and COX-2 proteins and restrained the phosphorylation of MAPK and the activation of NF-kappaB signaling pathways in BV-2 cells. The anti-neuro-inflammatory mechanism of caeminaxin A has been studied systematically for the first time. Furthermore, biosynthesis pathways for compounds 1-20 were discussed. CONCLUSIONS: The new cassane diterpenoid, caeminaxin A, alleviated the expression of iNOS and COX-2 protein and down-regulated of intracellular MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. The results implied that cassane diterpenoids had potential to be developed into therapeutic agents for neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：苦石莲（Caesalpinia minax Hance）的种子在中国被称为“苦石莲”，在民间医药中用于治疗风湿、痢疾和皮肤瘙痒。然而，其叶子的抗神经炎症成分及其机制鲜有报道。研究目的：从苦石莲叶子中寻找新的抗神经炎症化合物，并阐明其抗神经炎症作用的机制。材料与方法：通过HPLC和各种柱色谱技术对苦石莲乙酸乙酯部位的主要代谢物进行分析和纯化。利用1D和2D NMR、HR-ESI-MS以及单晶X射线衍射分析阐明其结构。在LPS诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞中评估抗神经炎症活性。通过western blotting分析NF-kappaB和MAPK信号通路中分子的表达水平。同时，通过western blotting检测iNOS和COX-2等相关蛋白的时间依赖性和剂量依赖性表达。此外，使用分子对接模拟对化合物1和3在NF-kappaB p65活性位点进行对接，以阐明分子水平的抑制机制。结果：从苦石莲叶子中分离出20种卡山烷二萜类化合物，包括两种新化合物（caeminaxins A和B）。Caeminaxins A和B的结构中具有罕见的不饱和羰基部分。大多数代谢物表现出强效抑制作用，IC(50)值范围为10.86 ± 0.82至32.55 ± 0.47 μM。其中，caeminaxin A显著抑制BV-2细胞中iNOS和COX-2蛋白的表达，并抑制MAPK的磷酸化和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。首次系统研究了caeminaxin A的抗神经炎症机制。此外，讨论了化合物1-20的生物合成途径。结论：新卡山烷二萜类化合物caeminaxin A减轻了iNOS和COX-2蛋白的表达，并下调了细胞内MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路。结果表明，卡山烷二萜类化合物有潜力被开发为治疗神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病）的治疗药物。
